title: Running a webhook-triggered scenario through the API succeeds with 0 operations
cause: A run request does not supply a payload to a custom webhook trigger, so the trigger has nothing to emit and the run ends at once.
fix: Trigger webhook scenarios by sending an HTTP request to the webhook URL. To run modules on demand from the API, build an action-only scenario with no trigger and on-demand scheduling; a run then executes each module once in module id order.
apply: Scenario scheduling {"type": "on-demand"} with an action as the first module, then POST /api/v2/scenarios/{id}/run with {"responsive": true}
affected: Make API v2 and the Make MCP scenarios_run tool, September 2026
